description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange, which provides a schema interchange format for HTMLPurifier configuration, including methods to add directives and perform validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange
classes.description: Represents a schema interchange format for HTMLPurifier configurations, allowing addition of directives and validation.

methods.name: addDirective
methods.description: Adds a directive to the directives array, preventing redefinition and throwing an exception if a directive with the same ID already exists.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs schema validation using an external validator class; throws an exception if validation fails.
